subject: science
concept: Collecting and organizing data in a table during an investigation
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Analyzing and Interpreting Data) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student records real or simulated measurements into a data table during a simple investigation
exercise.pictorial: Student fills in a partially completed data table using given information
exercise.abstract: Student organizes a described set of raw results into a properly labeled data table

misconception_flags: omits column/row labels or units, making the table unclear

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
